items.title: Plant Conservation & Native Genetic Diversity
items.description: Preserving heirloom cultivars—from landrace mango orchards in Rajshahi to wild wetland stands of sacred lotus—safeguards resilience against shifting monsoon patterns, salinity, and emerging crop pathogens.

image.imageAlt: Terraced emerald green flora stewardship landscape preserving heirloom botanical diversity

items.title: Pollination Guilds & Co-Evolved Mutualisms
items.description: Floral architecture directly reflects pollinator ecology: night-blooming jasmine attracts crepuscular moths via volatile terpenoids, while open sunflower capitula sustain native solitary bees and syrphid flies.

image.imageAlt: Foraging bee pollinating bright floral corolla in co-evolved insect-plant mutualism

items.title: Tropical & Subtropical Flora Adaptations
items.description: Across humid river deltas and monsoon plains, plants exhibit remarkable adaptations—aerial prop roots in banyans, waxy aerenchyma leaves in water lilies, and nitrogen-efficient bamboo rhizome networks.

image.imageAlt: Spreading tropical Ficus canopy showcasing humid monsoon adaptation and broad foliar crown
